label: DORA Art. 17

obligations.text: Financial entities shall define, establish and implement an ICT-related incident management process to detect, manage and notify ICT-related incidents.
Financial entities shall record all ICT-related incidents and significant cyber threats.

Financial entities shall establish appropriate procedures and processes to ensure a consistent and integrated monitoring, handling and follow-up of ICT-related incidents, to ensure that root causes are identified, documented and addressed in order to prevent the occurrence of such incidents.
